label: III.66 n. 2 [26153] — An agent gives esse insofar as it is a being in act
interpretation: Aquinas uses this premise and divine conservation to explain how inferior agents give being by divine power. The First Way treats an actual mover reducing a patient from potency to act. SCG III.66 explicitly applies the actuality condition to giving esse.
attribution: The passage states that an agent gives esse only insofar as it is a being in act, which is the premise.
